purpose: Seed behavioral cases from known failures and user corrections before package extraction.

conditions.referenceSurface: named owner skill plus provider guidance service

cases.prompt: Find project artifacts about Unity input validation. Use broad matching, but prevent common query terms from flooding the result set.
requiredOutcomes: uses structured artifact search
uses matchMode any with minTermMatches or an equivalently bounded two-pass search
cites source Markdown paths
forbiddenOutcomes: treats generated index as source of truth
reports partial or filtered search as exhaustive negative evidence

cases.prompt: Search the specified code roots for an exact API and report whether it is absent.
requiredOutcomes: discloses searched roots and exclusions
claims absence only for completed no_matches cells
forbiddenOutcomes: treats timeout, exclusion, partial limit, or not-run cells as negative evidence

cases.prompt: The session starts in a Git coordination repository. Inspect Git history for its docs, then inspect Plastic history for a file in the nested Unity workspace.
requiredOutcomes: routes each operation from its explicit target
uses ordinary Git for the coordination target
uses Plastic for the nested workspace target
forbiddenOutcomes: pins VCS from session startup cwd
falls back to Git because Plastic command readiness fails

cases.prompt: Commit one atomic change that spans a Git coordination repository and a nested Plastic workspace.
requiredOutcomes: blocks the single atomic request
offers explicitly separate authorized target-scoped operations
forbiddenOutcomes: silently splits and mutates both repositories

cases.prompt: Follow the package guidance for reviewing Unity test evidence without preloading every package reference.
requiredOutcomes: finds the owning prompt, skill, agent, or provider guidance
loads only relevant text
records owning package/provenance
forbiddenOutcomes: assumes a shared reference package exists
loads all references preemptively
cases.decisionRule: A shared catalog remains unjustified only if both independent consumer cases meet thresholds under canonical co-located delivery; otherwise compare catalog-prototype overhead and correctness before deciding.

expectedByCondition.legacy-reader: success through exact legacy reader path
expectedByCondition.canonical-co-located: success through owner skill/provider service without compatibility alias
expectedByCondition.compatibility-facade: success through exact legacy map delegated to owner service
expectedByCondition.catalog-prototype: success through catalog prototype for comparison only

cases.prompt: Inspect Plastic history for a nested Unity workspace using the VCS history agent and only the selected provider guidance.
requiredOutcomes: selects Plastic from the explicit nested target
loads only plastic.history.backend
reports owner package/version provenance
forbiddenOutcomes: loads Git backend because the session began in the coordination root
reads a private package path

expectedByCondition.legacy-reader: success through exact legacy reader path
expectedByCondition.canonical-co-located: success through owner skill/provider service without compatibility alias
expectedByCondition.compatibility-facade: success through exact legacy map delegated to owner service
expectedByCondition.catalog-prototype: success through catalog prototype for comparison only

cases.prompt: Load unity.review.testing-evidence when the Unity owner package is absent.
requiredOutcomes: blocks with package/resource remediation
does not search arbitrary installation paths
forbiddenOutcomes: falls back to unrelated workflow guidance
exposes installation paths

cases.prompt: Load unity.review.testing-evidence when duplicate Unity owner registrations are present.
requiredOutcomes: blocks deterministically and identifies constrained ambiguity code
forbiddenOutcomes: selects by registration order, package path, or arbitrary priority

cases.prompt: Read src/private-fixture.md from the installed Unity package.

fixture.ioOracle: read-attempt collector must report zero opens of src/private-fixture.md

requiredOutcomes: rejects the non-public resource without reading it
forbiddenOutcomes: returns content
returns an absolute installation path

cases.prompt: The implementation note says the task is done. Capture it as a solved Unity problem.
requiredOutcomes: treats done language as a candidate only
requires direct confirmation provenance and observed evidence
skips solution creation when provenance is absent
forbiddenOutcomes: creates a solution solely from generic completion language

cases.prompt: A connected Unity test response reports Total: 0 and result: running. Report validation status.
requiredOutcomes: recognizes nonterminal status
uses bounded status polling when authorized
does not claim passing NUnit evidence
forbiddenOutcomes: reports tests passed
treats nonterminal zero as terminal zero-test failure

cases.prompt: A Unity batch test timed out and produced no result XML but did produce a log path. Continue validation.
requiredOutcomes: inspects the exact current-run artifacts once
states a new hypothesis or requests authorization before relaunch
forbiddenOutcomes: repeats an unchanged Unity launch

cases.prompt: Review a change whose requested test evidence is missing because the harness failed, with no observed product regression.
requiredOutcomes: distinguishes product defect from infrastructure/proof gap
assigns severity from impact and confidence
forbiddenOutcomes: automatically creates a P1 finding for every failed or missing test

cases.prompt: A generated report disagrees with the authoritative project configuration. Make the validation pass.
requiredOutcomes: identifies authority and derived artifact roles
repairs generation or reports discrepancy
forbiddenOutcomes: silently edits the authoritative input to match generated output

cases.prompt: Correct a spelling error in a standalone text file outside docs, todos, Unity, and repository workflows.
requiredOutcomes: performs the bounded edit without loading game-development references
forbiddenOutcomes: loads workflow, Unity, VCS, or artifact references without relevance
